status: 0.79.13 OPEN: core submission/notifier protocol integrated; T1-T6/A1-A2 remain open
scope: Explicit internal Device/GSP API: coherent SYS notifier ownership, typed C67D initialization/UPDATE, PUT/GET and hardware notifier polling. Method completion is not a visible-image or mode-commit claim. Passive bootfb remains default; no automatic invocation.

facts.notifier: Display-table heap owner holds up to nine private 4KB coherent SYS notifier allocations, physical DMA residency and a permanent CPU-WB map. Native RM child handles/CHIDs and exact physical extents enter the existing RAMHT. The table must be CE-published before channel creation. Note reset and reads are private serialized CPU/GPU protocol operations, not an app-visible BO or fabricated GPU-write lease.
facts.source_basis: NVIDIA570.144 nvRmAllocEvoDma/RmAllocEvoChannel allocate SYS NISO pushbuffers and notifiers; the documented vidmem-only exception concerns GF100/GF104. EvoWriteNotifier requires matching SYS/VRAM placement. This GA106 path pairs coherent SYS allocations and performs CPU fences, without BAR1 writes.
facts.methods: Core C67D context notifier; actual RM window mask RGB/ILUT/TAPS_2 usage bounds; notifier WRITE enable at offset0, cursor/window interlocks0, UPDATE RELEASE_ELV and notifier disable. Original C67D/C37B definitions and Nouveau ordering. No head/window image or SOR/timing state is emitted yet.
facts.ring: Physical 4KB pushbuffer remains CPU-mapped. One outstanding operation, monotone points, exact encoded command validation, dedicated typed Device admission and BOOT0-bracketed PUT/GET samples. Core user0x680000, PUT0/GET4, dword cursor bits11:2. Initial state requires hardware PUT0. Submission waits for previous notifier completion and GET==PUT.
facts.wrap: At the ring end, the producer writes reserved JUMP0 and publishes PUT0 while GET is nonzero. It waits for GET0 before overwriting the beginning, then separately publishes new work. There is no producer chasing an in-flight GET: one completed operation plus GET==PUT establishes the empty ring before reuse. No busy loop or reinterpretation of GET as completion.
facts.completion: Private 16-byte notifier status NOT_BEGUN/BEGUN stays pending; FINISHED records stable word0 plus timestamp. Invalid status, cursor, ambiguous memory descriptor, deadline or queued GSP fault retains reachable resources. Queued firmware notifications precede completion publication. Work serializes against common CE jobs, private table uploads, RM factories and teardown.
facts.retirement: Actual channel Free ACK plus physical idle/deallocation permits CPU unmap and release of its command buffer. A completed notifier or GET does not permit release. Notifier/table/instance remain held after channel Free because active display resource retirement requires a separate transition protocol.

validation.reference: 484-byte original-header C fixture: sparse/full/single-window initialization and repeated UPDATE, JUMP0, PUT/GET boundaries and notifier fields. Twelve full pinned originals and complete notices archived; derived Zig protocol code carries full applicable notices.
validation.device: Six scenarios inside the existing actual Device test: 128-update success with ring wrap and physical retirement; timeout; already queued GSP fault; malformed hardware cursor; invalid notifier status; malformed permanent notifier CPU mapping. Actual Device admission rejects copied owner, wrong deadline, altered commands or notifier handle. GET and BEGUN do not complete. Failure keeps CPU/DMA storage live.
validation.guest: No unchanged QEMU rerun; Kernel/Contract/SDK/common queues unchanged.
validation.limits: Host model and byte-reference checks establish software behavior only. No real GPU execution, visible scanout, HDMI sound or mode adoption was tested.

sources.fixture: Original C67D/C37B/507C class definitions and Nouveau DRF macros, no Zig encoder linked.

attribution.notice_normalization: Added trailing whitespace only; all prior license bytes preserved
